claim: On 1,972 SPY days (2018-2026, end-of-day GEX, FlashAlpha vendor backtest, no trading costs), the top-minus-bottom GEX quintile difference in next-day realized vol was not significant after controlling for VIX and ATM IV (-0.99 vol points, p=0.25); not tested OOS.
quote: For GEX, the top-minus-bottom residualized realized-vol difference tells the same story: -10.63 vol points raw, -3.15 after VIX, and -0.99 after VIX + ATM IV (p = 0.25).
title: FlashAlpha GEX/DEX/VEX/CHEX 8-year SPY backtest

claim: In the same FlashAlpha SPY test, end-of-day dealer delta exposure (DEX) did not predict next-day SPY direction (top-minus-bottom return 0.00%, p=0.97).
quote: Top-minus-bottom return difference is 0.00%, t = 0.04, p = 0.97. Raw Spearman ρ is -0.03 with p = 0.19. DEX does not predict next-day SPY direction in this EOD test.
title: FlashAlpha GEX/DEX/VEX/CHEX 8-year SPY backtest

claim: FlashAlpha study of 193 SPY 0DTE sessions (Jul 2022-Apr 2026, minute data): the 10:00 ET straddle-implied move contained the close 71.0% of sessions (68.3% if fairly priced); realized moves ~13% below implied; worst miss +8.72% vs 3.51% implied. Close-to-close containment, not high-low range.
quote: The 10:00 ET implied move contained the close 71.0% of the time (68.3% if fairly priced), realized moves ran about 13% below what the straddle implied, and the worst single miss was a +8.72% day against a 3.51% implied move.
title: Are 0DTE Straddles Overpriced? 193 SPY Sessions

claim: Journal of Futures Markets 2025: VIX1D overestimates S&P 500 volatility (risk premium); an adjusted VIX1D gives a parsimonious 1-day volatility forecast.
quote: We show that the VIX1D overestimates the volatility of the S&P 500 and propose an easy‐to‐implement proxy to adjust for the inherent risk premium.
title: VIX1D paper, J. Futures Markets 45(11)

claim: Pan & Poteshman (RFS 2006; sample 1990-2001, CBOE, stock options, buyer-initiated open volume): low put-call-ratio stocks outperform high ratio stocks by >40 bp next day and >1% next week, risk-adjusted. Sample ends 2001: outdated, no costs, no post-2010 replication found.
quote: On a risk-adjusted basis, stocks with low put-call ratios outperform stocks with high put-call ratios by more than 40 basis points on the next day and more than 1% over the next week.
title: The Information in Option Volume for Future Stock Prices (NBER w10925)

claim: Princeton senior thesis (Apr 2026): canonical Gamma-induced hedging feedback adds no meaningful predictive power for intraday variance forecasts (QLIKE, correlation); other option risk exposures predict better.
quote: Our empirical results show that the canonical hedging feedback channel does not add meaningful predictive power for intraday variance forecasts
title: Princeton thesis on 0DTE and intraday volatility

claim: Baltussen et al. (JFE 2021): in S&P futures, intraday momentum (last 30 min predicted by rest-of-day return) is much stronger on negative net-gamma-exposure days; none significant on positive NGE days. Sample to 2020, futures, no option-buying P&L.
quote: Table 7 shows that indeed intraday momentum is much more pronounced on negative NGE days. On days with positive NGE, however, there is no significant intraday momentum.
title: Hedging Demand and Market Intraday Momentum (paper text via Alpha Architect page)
